A '''bovistrangler tree''' is a tree found only in a dungeon in [[Daemonheim]]. It requires 50 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped down and can yield 1-9 [[Bovistrangler branches]] before depletion. Each of the logs give 175 experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
